description: Returns git commit history for a project (all vaults) or a single vault. Provide exactly one of project_id or vault_id. Requires full data access (a paid plan; verification-only plans are not included). Requires X-API-Key (existing users can generate an API key in the web app). If headers aren't supported, pass api_key in arguments.

inputSchema.description: Provide exactly one of project_id or vault_id.

api_key.description: Optional API key for clients that cannot set X-API-Key headers.

author.description: Filter: exact match on commit author (case-insensitive).

branch.description: Filter: exact match on branch name.

date_from.description: Filter: commits on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_to.description: Filter: commits on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination.

project_id.description: Project id (from create_project). Returns data aggregated across all vaults in the project.

vault_id.description: Vault id (from create-code-vault or list_vaults). Returns data for this vault only.

name: get-git-history
